text:
GitHub Copilot's CLI just stopped asking you which model to use.

What changed: Copilot CLI now auto-routes each session to the right model based on the task's complexity - no more manually swapping models mid-build.

What it does: simple edits get a fast, cheap model. Gnarly multi-file refactors get routed to a heavier one - automatically, every session.

Builder value: you stop micromanaging model choice and start focusing on the actual problem. Less tab-switching, fewer wasted tokens on the wrong tool for the job.

Try this: run a mixed session this week - a quick fix and a real refactor back to back - and watch which model handles each one without you touching a setting.

Signal: the model is becoming infrastructure, not a decision. GPT-5.6, Claude Sonnet 5, and Meta's new Muse Spark are all racing to be invisible, not chosen.

Comment BUILD and I will send you the workflow map.
